Home / House collections / Victorian

Kikoloni · 0.25 – 0.75 acre

Victorian

A colonial-era silhouette with a modern core. Steep gables shed Nairobi rain fast, tall sash windows pull hot air out at the ridge, and the deep eaves keep the afternoon sun off the glass.

KES 24.5M Price band
40 wks Build time
0.25 – 0.75 acre Plot range
4/5/6 bed Plans available

Why this design

High ceilings, gabled roofs and rooms that breathe.

The Victorian gable is not nostalgia. It is a rain-shedding machine: a 42-degree pitch moves water off a roof three times faster than a shallow pitch, which matters when Nairobi delivers 40 mm in an hour. We kept the proportions and replaced the internals — lime mortar, insulated roof deck, sealed double glazing and a service core that carries every smart cable without cutting into the original detailing.
